note: Everything Blackwell Engine Native 1.0 is built from, pinned. Order: extract wine, apply highball patches-arm64 (all, sorted), apply patches-arm64-xbox/0100, run engine/build-native.sh, then engine/package-native.sh with the three Highball archives below.

blackwell-xbox-patch.from: engine/patches 0001, 0002, 0004, 0006 to 0009 and 0012, ported to Wine 11.18; 0003 (macOS %gs TEB slots) and 0005 (x86-64 exception traces) are x86-64 only and left out; 0008's concurrent_vector hunks are upstream in 11.18; its concurrent queue iterator (which Forza Horizon 6 calls: FHE01 without it, issue #14) is ported since Native 1.1

highball-engine-r4.takes: FEX (xtajit64.dll, xtajit.dll, lib*fex.so), winegstreamer, engine/lib host libraries, Wine Mono and Gecko, frameworks/

loader.note: Not in the bundle: MetalHorizon installs it from Highball's release and checks its signature (components.json, wineloader).
